chapter_title: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
chapter_title_arabic: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود

duas.title: Supplication between Yemeni Corner and Black Stone
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanah wa fi 'l-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā `adhāban-nār
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world, and the good things in the next life, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حسَنَةً وفي الآخِرَةِ حسَنةً وقِنَا عذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
duas.grading: Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/354
duas.additional_notes: The Ayat is from Surat Al-Baqarah, 2:201
